description: Before a run of small paid calls to one seller (a stream of x402 calls at a cent each, say), open one budget for the run instead of checking every call. Your owner's spend policy judges the session like a purchase of max_amount: allow holds that maximum against today's cap and returns reservation.id, the session id; ask means a person approves the budget first, then send the same request again; deny means do not start. Then call draw_session_spend right before paying each call, and close_spend_session when done, which gives back what you did not draw. A session left open gives its remainder back when it expires. Only where the workspace has sessions switched on (else an error with code not_released: use check_purchase per purchase). Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: Only with a workspace-wide key: open it on behalf of this agent. An agent key always acts as itself.

agentid_token.description: Your AgentID ID token, issued for Last Price, when your owner's policy lets only verified agents spend. Sent as the AgentID-Token header.

category.description: Optional: its category, when the policy limits or budgets categories.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Defaults to USD.

intent.description: Optional: what the buyer approved for this purchase, from an American Express intent, an AP2 intent mandate, or declared by you. A purchase that names another seller, costs more than max_amount (counting every purchase under the same intent_id), is in another currency or comes after expires_at is denied, whatever the policy allows. evidence (the token or mandate) is kept only as a hash and is not verified yet. Only where the workspace has intents switched on (else an error with code not_released).

evidence.description: The Proof of Intent Token or the mandate; only its SHA-256 is kept.

intent_id.description: The Intent ID, or the mandate id.

max_amount.description: The most the buyer approved across every purchase under this intent. Needs currency.
The most the whole run may spend.

pay_to.description: Optional: the wallet address (bare or CAIP-10) or merchant account id the calls pay. Every draw_session_spend must then name the same one: another is refused with code payee_changed. Only where the workspace has payee binding switched on (else an error with code not_released).

seller.description: Who the calls pay: an API, domain or wallet name.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the session stays open, in seconds. Defaults to 3600.

name: open_spend_session
